title: PemTheO.P - Wave Rider
htmlContent:
PemTheO.P drops a dope single called "Wave Rider". The song "Wave Rider" is a energetic Hip Hop and Electronic funk song with a great bounce to it. His music makes you dream, and allows you to let the music guides you to the perfect destination, courtesy of his artistry. With “Wave Rider” you hear the apparent talent to the fullest, but also able to feel every moving part of the record in your soul, to show what art is all about.

PemTheO.P's Wave Rider is a record that shows how fun and enjoyable music can be that’s just in time. It packs an infinite amount of appeal to be the music you can hear being played all over the world, while being able to make a record that’s enjoyable for the masses on this sure fire hit.
